fields.name: Fade
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 copies the first 0x18 bytes as an STDString (ls::STDString copy constructor; small-string test 'capacity at +0x14 > 0xF', size at +0x10) into the 0x28-byte clear-screen-fade request it emits, and assigns it with bg3.exe+0x4122F50 when an entry is created. Game struct name (macOS): esv::timeline::CurrentFadeInData.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 writes 0x41A00000 (20.0) when the entry is created, subtracts the frame delta (GameTime + 8) every frame and, at <= 0, emits a request with duration 0x3E4CCCCD (0.2) and removes the entry (bg3.exe+0x2D11C90). Matches esv::timeline::FadeSystem::c_TimelineFadeInFinishedTimeout / c_TimeoutClearScreenDuration exported by the Toolkit.

fields.name: Timeouts
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 (called from esv::timeline::FadeSystem update bg3.exe+0x2D10010; registration bg3.exe+0x235BC10, callback bg3.exe+0x2393ED0) fetches the singleton with stride 0x40; keys are 4 bytes (array at +0x20 walked with stride 4, hash = key % size, compared as uint32), values at +0x30 with stride 0x20. The keys looked up come from the system's set at +0x10..+0x40, filled with 4-byte user ids of finished fade-ins (the Toolkit exports FadeSystem::LEGACY_OsirisRequestFadeOut(float, net::UserID const&) and the component esv::timeline::FadedInUsersComponent). Probe: empty. macOS names the map type ls::HashMap<net::UserID, esv::timeline::CurrentFadeInData> (RemoveNode, ~CurrentFadeInData in the esv::timeline::FadeSystem code): the key is a net::UserID. Live: 11 instances with allocated buckets (count 5) and empty key/value arrays.

open_questions: What the string is (the name/id of the screen fade to clear) - named Fade descriptively.
second_pass: Windows bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 gives the key width (4), value stride 0x20, STDString at +0 and float at +0x18; macOS names the map HashMap<net::UserID, esv::timeline::CurrentFadeInData>, which settles the key as a UserId. STDString is a builtin of generate.py now (24 bytes), so the earlier external_types override was removed.
